artifacts.summary: Six-phase sequential plan: fix the Component 4a over-declaring guidance first, add proposed_file_scope + --file-scope-add additive write-back, then apply the per-declaration narrowings and verify Check 8 plus the three preserved genuine collisions.

memory_candidates.content: When a task's declared file_scope omits files its own plan must edit, the safe repair is an additive union via state-write.sh (never an array replacement), because active_projects[].file_scope may have been changed independently by other writers between read and write. This is the same additive-only discipline that makes a research-postflight file_scope write-back categorically safe against false negatives: under-declaring silently removes the collision guard between concurrent agents, while over-declaring only costs an orchestration cycle. Any mechanism that mutates file_scope should therefore be union-only by construction, not by author care.
